risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (could be a different Yamaha PSR series or another brand) which changes Lagos resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (e.g., PSR-E453) on the top panel, plus the rear label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic 61-key portable keyboard (worst-case for value vs the claimed PSR-E453).

risks.risk: Not working / partial faults (keys, power, speakers, buttons, display, sound output). Photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, working display, playing several keys, and volume/speaker output (or headphone output).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not obvious from one photo (missing/warped keys, cracked casing, damaged speaker grille, broken knobs).
risks.proof: Photos of both ends and the underside, plus close-ups of the speaker area, knobs, and the full keybed (straight-on).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

risks.risk: Accessories/packaging missing (power adapter, stand, manual) affecting buyer cost.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included: charger/adapter, any stand, and manuals; show the adapter label.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (no adapter/stand unless shown).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model label showing the exact Yamaha model number (PSR-E453) on the keyboard body.
Video: power-on + display, then play a short melody across multiple keys, and show sound through the built-in speaker (and/or headphone jack).
Photo of the rear/underside labels and ports (power, headphone, sustain, etc.).
Photo of included items (especially the power adapter) and confirm whether any stand/manual is included.
response.reason: The photos show a 61-key portable keyboard, but the exact Yamaha PSR-E453 model cannot be confirmed from the image, and functionality/accessories are not verifiable remotely. Proof is needed to price confidently.
